answer: Each identity leases one distinct vending unit on a registered pitch — a knoll kiosk, a falcon clubhouse, a delta ferry dock — its payment terminal bound to one account only. Verifiers check processor logs for 60+ real sales monthly from 30 different cards, plus random timestamped photos of stock levels; a shared terminal or cloned log revokes the slot. One unit costs $1,900 plus $140 monthly rent and weekly restocking, so 1,000 Sybils need $1.9 million in machines and real buyers per fake. Trade-off: low-footfall pitches qualify slowly.
